incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: Spike in 5xx from model-serving runtime (prod-us-east-1). Errors: SIGSEGV / OOM in model-runner. Start ~14:02Z. Paging SRE.
marco (oncall): Oncall here, stepping in. Any quick blindingly obvious changes?
sunita (sre): Seeing lots of segfault traces and kernel OOMs in the logs. ~6-8% error rate overall, some customers higher.
eva (eng-ml): Which model variants are affected? We rolled out quantized-attention heuristics yesterday to v2 models.
chris (runtime): Correlating now. Early signal: high token lengths causing KV cache blowout + quant kernel hitting a cornercase -> OOM/segfault.
marco (oncall): Good call. Mitigation plan: 1) route traffic off quantized variant -> small-model fallback 2) throttle burst RPS 3) roll nodes with recent kernel modules disabled.
ops-bot: Executing temp route change: routing 30% -> small-model-v1 for prod-us-east-1 (cmd: routerctl set-route --from model-v2-q --to small-model-v1 --pct 30).
sunita (sre): Logs & commands I'm running: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-runner --since=15m | egrep -i "segfault|oom|double free"``` Also checking dmesg on gpu nodes. Seeing repeated "Out of memory: Kill process" from model-runner.
chris (runtime): Quick hot config: disable quant-attention path: set ENV QUANT_KERNEL=false on affected pool (will trigger restart). Command: ```infractl pool update --pool inference-quant --env QUANT_KERNEL=false --rolling 1```
eva (eng-ml): Spin up canary with smaller context window and non-quantized build: model-v2-safe. If stable we can shift majority traffic.
marco (oncall): Running customer impact calc: aggregate errors ~7% last 10m, 95th latency increased 220ms. Top impacted customers: AcmeCorp and EmailAI (traffic weight ~12% each) seeing 25-40% failures. Notifying CSMs.
sunita (sre): Post-mitigation telemetry: after initial 30% reroute and disabling quant kernel on two pods, errors trending down to 2.1%. Continuing roll.
chris (runtime): Found a reproducible segfault with long prompts + batch size 8 on quant kernel. Filed issue #RT-4287 and attaching stacktrace. Hotpatch: revert quant kernel to previous safe release v1.9.
eva (eng-ml): Keep the quant kernel disabled for now. We'll run regression tests against our eval set and iterate.
marco (oncall): I'll prepare a short incident note for internal postmortem and notify on-call for night shift handoff at 22:00Z. On-call handover to sunita in 30m.
ops-bot: Notifying statuspage: partial degradation -> inference generation (prod-us-east-1).
sunita (sre): Confirming mitigation: roll completed across pool, fallback routing to small-model-v1 increased to 60% while we validate. No new OOMs in last 12m on rolled nodes.
marco (oncall): Thanks team. Next actions: (a) runtime to push hotfix revert, (b) ML to run regression on quant opt, (c) SRE to monitor 1h and prepare post-incident summary. Tagging incident follow-up. :thumbsup:
